home.title: See how customers react to your ad before you pay for it.
home.subtitle: Upload your ad, describe your business and audience, and watch a virtual audience of thousands react in minutes. You get a score, the funnel, comments and the reasons behind every number.
home.ctaNote: No card needed for the first test. Standard tier included.

reasons.title: Read the reasons
reasons.body: Every number comes with its evidence: who stopped, who skipped, what they asked, and why.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: Three tiers, priced per test. Prices are in USD; where a local currency is set up we show an approximate local amount.
pricing.localHint: Choose your country to see approximate local prices.

tiers.quick: A fast read: fewer runs, one audience.
tiers.standard: The balanced choice for most tests.
tiers.full: Most runs, all scenarios, up to three named audiences.

pricing.trialBody: Your first test is free on the Standard tier after you verify your e-mail. No card required.
pricing.methodsBody: Card payments through Stripe. In Myanmar you can pay by bank or mobile wallet transfer with a payment code; an admin confirms the order, usually within a few hours.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: ADVAR simulates how a virtual audience reacts to your ad. Here is what happens between upload and report.

profile.title: Business Profile
profile.body: You describe your business once: what you sell, your customers, your reputation. Presets are versioned so every test records exactly what it used.

ad.title: Your ad
ad.body: Upload an image or short video with caption, headline and call to action. The system reads the ad: hook, offer, visual quality and trust signals.

audience.title: Audience
audience.body: Country, locations, language groups, ages, gender and interests. The virtual population is built from country data and your profile.

simulation.title: Simulation
simulation.body: Thousands of virtual customers with different patience, skepticism and price sensitivity see the ad across scenarios like payday or a rainy weekend. Runs repeat until the estimate stabilises.

report.title: Report
report.body: Score, funnel, comments, segments, brand relationship, timing and blockers, each with the evidence behind it. A PDF matches the web report.

honesty.title: Honest by design
honesty.body: The report states what happened and why. It never tells you what to change. New businesses are simulated as new businesses.

service.title: The service
service.body: ADVAR provides simulated audience reactions to advertising material. Results are estimates produced by a model and are not guarantees of real-world performance.

simulation.title: Simulation results
simulation.body: Scores, funnels, comments and reasons are generated by virtual audiences. You remain responsible for decisions taken on the basis of a report.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Tests are paid per run. Card payments are processed by Stripe. Manual transfers are confirmed by our team; unconfirmed orders expire after 48 hours.

cancel.title: Cancelling a test
cancel.body: A test can be cancelled while it is preparing, before results start. The first cancellation allows one free restart of the same test; a second cancellation requires a new payment.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: You must keep your login details safe. We may block accounts that abuse the free trial or the service.

data.title: What we store
data.body: Your account details, Business Profiles, ads and reports. Reports are kept so you can compare versions over time.

media.title: Ad media
media.body: Uploaded images and videos are stored to run the simulation and generate the report. Frames may be sent to an AI provider for analysis.

payments.title: Payment data
payments.body: We never see your card number. For manual transfers we store the payment code, amount and the reference you provide.

retention.title: Retention and deletion
retention.body: You can delete your account from Settings. Personal data is removed; anonymised aggregate statistics may be kept.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about your data can be sent to the address shown on the invoice or receipt.
